item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Sia throws leftover cooked rice into the bin. Farmers and community members grew, harvested, and brought that rice from farm to plate.

Which claim best connects avoiding food waste with that work?

options.A: Wasting that rice also wastes the time and effort of the farmers and community who brought it from farm to plate.
options.B: Regions with fewer kinds of food show more respect for farmers.
options.C: It is fine to waste cheap rice because cheap food took no effort to produce.
options.D: Only food grown on big farms deserves care; leftover home-cooked rice can be thrown without wasting anyone's work.
